text:
zoe: quick heads-up from testing the roles matrix + invite drawer combo. if you open the invite drawer and then quickly toggle SSO, the form validation moves focus to the top of the org page (behind the drawer). keyboard-only users lose context.
matt: thanks. repro steps?
zoe: 1) org settings -> members 2) open invite drawer 3) set role to Admin 4) toggle SSO on/off fast 5) press tab. focus ends up on the main page header.
indra: that sounds like a focus trap missing when the microstate changes. probably the drawer's focus-lock library doesn't know about the reflow.
ryan: is this related to the audit log nav? we added a persistent breadcrumb that can claim focus when the page updates.
zoe: maybe. the breadcrumb DOM gets a live update when SSO toggles. screen reader announces "navigation updated" and the keyboard lands there.
matt: two parts: 1) prevent global nav from stealing focus on ephemeral invite interactions. 2) clarify copy for the SSO toggle. current tooltip is "Enforce SSO" which confused support.
indra: copy proposals: a) "Require company SSO for invited users" b) short on control: "Require SSO for new users". I'm leaning to (b) for compact UIs. add a doc link for edge cases.
ryan: for nav issue, suggestion: make the breadcrumb updates non-focusable (aria-live="polite" only, no focus shifts), and ensure the drawer retains aria-hidden=false and focus trap active until drawer close. also queue live messages in a role=status region.
a11y-bot: checklist: 1) ensure focus-lock library re-evaluates tabbable nodes after DOM updates; 2) add aria-live (status) for invite success/errors; 3) remove autofocus on breadcrumb on programmatic updates.
zoe: design tweak: collapse the roles matrix rows when drawer is open (visual cue) so users see the modal context better. but watch for contrast and motion prefs.
matt: implementation note: when drawer opens add data-drawer-open on body; css will dim matrix and pointer-events:none. that should avoid accidental focusable elements. but still need JS to trap focus.
indra: animation/accessibility: follow prefers-reduced-motion, shorten transitions to 100ms, and use opacity-only transitions where possible to keep layout stable.
ryan: audit log nav idea: offer a small "quick-close" keyboard hint at top of drawer (Esc to close) so users know how to exit without reaching the page header.
zoe: can someone add a small copy change PR for the SSO text + inline helper? i'll file the issue for the focus trap. target: patch in next sprint.
matt: i'll take copy + micro-visual, indra will pick focus-lock changes, ryan will add breadcrumb update guard, a11y-bot will run the regression script after PRs.
a11y-bot: created issue: #INV-4823 - invite drawer focus trap causing focus loss after SSO toggle.
zoe: thanks team. tiny follow-up: on high-contrast themes the role chip outline is barely visible when selected. add a 2px outline in those modes.
matt: noted. pulling everything into a tiny spec doc and labels now.
